title: Tyler Guyton focused on "coming to work and getting better" amid Cowboys left tackle competition

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Guyton focused on "coming to work and getting better" amid Cowboys left tackle competition
sources.description: When the Cowboys drafted Tyler Guyton in the first round of the 2024 draft, they probably didn't envision him competing with a seventh-round pick from the same class entering his third NFL season.
